summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily share repurchases under its buyback program announced 5 August 2026. On 7 September 2026, HSBC purchased 10,000 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of £15.7808 per share and 359,200 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$167.2195 average. Shares were bought from BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC for cancellation. Since program commencement, HSBC repurchased 26,404,614 shares for approximately US$544.3 million total consideration. The buyback reduces issued share capital and voting rights. Watch for ongoing buyback pace and impact on capital ratios; risk-arbitage not applicable as this is an issuer market buyback.
